# KAN SIMD baseline research command manifest

All commands were run from the `cwd` shown below.  `raw.log` contains direct
combined stdout/stderr; its paired `.exit` contains the numeric child exit.
The shell wrapper captured the child exit as `test_exit`; a successful wrapper
does not change the recorded child exit.  No log is hand-abbreviated.

## Shared values

- Research cwd: `/private/tmp/goai-kan-simd-research-XNMqPD/repo`
- Pristine comparison cwd: `/private/tmp/goai-bce-clean-baseline-NodpS5/repo`
- Pinned environment for native Go invocations:
  `PATH=/private/tmp/goai-go1271-j1cLvq/go/bin:$PATH GOCACHE=/private/tmp/gocache-goai GOMODCACHE=/private/tmp/goai-go1271-j1cLvq/modcache GOTOOLCHAIN=local CGO_ENABLED=0`
- Pinned compiler: `go version go1.27.1 darwin/arm64`.
- Final diagnostic source artifact:
  `kan_simd_baseline_diagnostic_test.go`, SHA-256
  `284e0869f3c96c6188e7a1ab47ddc6156f00718bf28d57092631cb24c76f2fa9`.
  Its genuine add-file patch is `kan_simd_baseline_diagnostic.add.patch`; the
  `git diff --no-index` child exit is intentionally `1` in
  `kan_simd_baseline_diagnostic.add.patch.exit`.

## Unchanged-source arm64 KAN test

Each row’s exact argv is
`go test ./nn -run '^TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical$' -count=1 -v` with the
shared pinned environment plus the stated `GOEXPERIMENT`.

| Raw log and exit | cwd | GOEXPERIMENT | Diagnostic source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `research-default-raw.log`, `research-default.exit` | research | `''` | absent |
| `research-simd-raw.log`, `research-simd.exit` | research | `simd` | absent |
| `c6-default-raw.log`, `c6-default.exit` | pristine comparison | `''` | absent |
| `c6-simd-raw.log`, `c6-simd.exit` | pristine comparison | `simd` | absent |

## Temporary arm64 diagnostic

Each row’s exact argv is
`go test ./nn -run '^TestKANSIMDBaselineDiagnostic$' -count=1 -v` with the
research cwd, shared pinned environment, and stated `GOEXPERIMENT`.

| Raw log and exit | GOEXPERIMENT | Diagnostic source version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `diagnostic-default-raw.log`, `diagnostic-default.exit` | `''` | earlier temporary revision: stage/fused/generic/serial instrumentation; source was not retained |
| `diagnostic-simd-raw.log`, `diagnostic-simd.exit` | `simd` | same earlier unretained revision |
| `diagnostic-hybrid-simd-raw.log`, `diagnostic-hybrid-simd.exit` | `simd` | earlier temporary revision adding ref-SiLU hybrid; source was not retained |
| `diagnostic-causal-simd-raw.log`, `diagnostic-causal-simd.exit` | `simd` | final retained source SHA-256 above |

The final diagnostic was applied only at
`nn/kan_simd_baseline_diagnostic_test.go`, then removed with `apply_patch` and
its lease released. The final source is retained outside the repo solely for
reproduction of the final causal log.

it is not evidence. Use the retained source plus `.add.patch` instead.
